posts.text:
Opus 5.5 is said to arrive Tuesday, 20 percent cheaper than Opus 5

Accounts circulating since Sunday put the model at $4 and $20 per million tokens, testing under the codename claude-wafer-eap and strongest at 3D and front-end work.

https://theaipost.net/story/opus55-rumour/

Meta's Muse tops ChatGPT's first 12 days on mobile, TechCrunch says

Third-party estimates cited by TechCrunch put Muse at 1.8 million iOS downloads in the US and Canada over 12 days, against 1.3 million for ChatGPT.

https://theaipost.net/story/muse-download-lead/

SoftBank's SB Energy delays IPO over $50 billion valuation, NYT says

The New York Times reported that the data centre developer has delayed an offering planned for this month, as investors questioned a valuation of $50 billion or more.

https://theaipost.net/story/sb-energy-ipo-delay/

Newsom signs 7 bills tightening oversight of California data centres

Reuters reported that the package covers electricity costs, water use and local review, after the governor vetoed a similar water bill last year.

https://theaipost.net/story/california-datacentre-bills/

Shopify opens Shop Pay checkout to Meta's Muse agent

Tobi Lutke said the arrangement covers every Shopify store, two days after Amazon blocked the same agent from shopping on its own site.

https://theaipost.net/story/shopify-muse-checkout/

OpenAI asks US to lead global standards for self-improving AI

The company said fully autonomous recursive self-improvement is not happening today and should not be pursued unless it can be done safely.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-rsi-standards/

Qualcomm, Lumentum and Corning to demonstrate optical chip-to-chip link

Lumentum said its optical engine carries about 10 terabits a second of combined transmit and receive capacity in a proof-of-concept that has not shipped.

https://theaipost.net/story/qualcomm-optical-d2d/

Independent evaluators split on what Grok 4.7 improved

Artificial Analysis put the model in the top four on its intelligence index, while Vals AI measured a decline driven by finance and research tasks.

https://theaipost.net/story/grok47-independent-evals/

OpenAI names outside advisory group on mathematics results

The company said an independent group of mathematicians will guide how it reviews and communicates new mathematical results produced by its models.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-math-advisory/

SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.7, says it runs twice as fast

The company put the price at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. The speed claim is its own.

https://theaipost.net/story/grok47-launch/

Trump says AI fears are a hoax, backs existing law enforcement

The president said the United States leads China in artificial intelligence and that he will not stifle its growth, in a post on Truth Social.

https://theaipost.net/story/trump-ai-hoax/

AMD passes $1 trillion market value for the first time

Three market accounts reported the crossing on Monday. One put the gain at $284 billion over 18 days, a figure no other account carried.

https://theaipost.net/story/amd-trillion/

Google prices first Googlebooks from $899, ties Gemini to the desktop

The laptops run Android and come from partner manufacturers, with 5 models at launch, according to accounts summarising the announcement.

https://theaipost.net/story/googlebook-pricing/

UN panel says agent safeguards cannot wait for scientific certainty

The Independent International Scientific Panel on AI published its first thematic brief, arguing that loss-of-control risk may justify acting before the science is settled.

https://theaipost.net/story/un-agent-panel/

Amazon blocks Meta's Muse agent from shopping on its store

A popup told Muse users on Sunday that access by an unauthorised AI agent breaks Amazon's terms, GeekWire reported. The Verge said it asked Meta for comment.

https://theaipost.net/story/amazon-muse-block/

OpenAI and Anthropic discussed testing each other's models, The Information says

Five financial wire accounts relayed the report on Monday. All of them rest on the same outlet, and neither company has commented.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-anthropic-crosstest/

Meta says Petal subsea cable to carry 1 petabit a second

The cable will run about 7,000km between France and the United States and is expected in service in 2029, Meta said on Monday.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-petal-cable/

DeepSeek is training a 2-trillion-parameter model, The Information says

Liang Wenfeng told investors that training on Chinese chips has to work, according to summaries of the report. DeepSeek has not commented.

https://theaipost.net/story/c045f575d/

Nvidia's Huang says AI has 0% chance of ending humanity

In a CBS Sunday Morning interview, the Nvidia chief executive dismissed AI extinction fears and said the industry does not need new safety regulation, Nvidia and The Verge reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/c828665c1/

SoftBank seeks $11 billion in bonds to boost OpenAI stake
https://theaipost.net/story/c25c3402c/

Bessent proposes US-China notification system for AI incidents

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has proposed a mechanism for the US and China to notify each other of AI incidents that reach the level of a national-security concern, two accounts reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/c1bb637ba/

Benchmarks split on speed between Laya and TypeSafe's Jev
https://theaipost.net/story/c24f3f7a5/
